description:
Choose the direction, throw the first ball and watch the beauty of the explosive gameplay. Each move creates multiple possibilities for you to choose from. Really simple and very addictive gameplay in your hands. Play again and again.

Try to find the best possible trajectory and let the mayhem begin! Just one correct move can create an amazing chain of explosions and block destruction. Search for the best choices and opportunities. It's up to you how and for how long you want to play! 

You can play endlessly if you can find the gameplay patterns. Collect bonuses, multiply the power, open hidden chests and unlock the ultimate possibilities as you break through the levels. 

Check out this fun new game from the NOSTRA.GAMES team. 

Smash them all!
name: Merge Numbers
intro: Merge the numbers and smash the blocks!
